2610.13330.title: Masked Diffusion Language Agents for Tool-Integrated Chemical Reasoning
2610.13330.paper_summary: Designing tool-integrated reasoning agent systems for complex chemical tasks remains a fundamental challenge. Although recent chemical agents have demonstrated promising performance through the integration of external tools, they are still built on the autoregressive paradigm, which is inherently constrained by causal attention and left-to-right generation. As a result, they often struggle with bidirectional molecular understanding, global coordinated tool planning and multi-source evidence integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDiffAgent, the first masked diffusion language agent for tool-integrated chemical reasoning. It reformulates chemical reasoning as iterative denoising over interleaved reasoning and tool-use trajectories, enabling tool-use decisions to be jointly determined under full-trajectory context and thereby better aligning the agent's decision boundary with its knowledge boundary. We further analyze how this paradigm benefits agentic reasoning through harder infilling subproblems during training and flexible arbitrary-order decoding during inference. Then we develop a two-stage post-training framework, comprising agentic supervised fine-tuning and variance-reduced preference optimization, to enhance tool-use and reasoning capabilities. We also construct a comprehensive benchmark covering six chemistry tasks across both single-turn and multi-turn tool-use scenarios. Under matched budgets and evaluation, ChemDiffAgent consistently outperforms autoregressive agents, achieving an overall improvement of approximately 20%. Notably, our 8B model achieves performance comparable to, in some cases surpassing, significantly larger frontier models, such as GPT 5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Code is available at https://github.com/bilemond/ChemDiffAgent.
2610.13330.paper_summary_zh: 設計工具整合推理代理系統以應對複雜的化學任務仍然是一項基本挑戰。儘管最近的化學代理通過整合外部工具展示了有希望的表現，但它們仍然建立在自回歸範式上，這本質上受到因果注意力和從左到右生成的限制。因此，它們在雙向分子理解、全球協調工具規劃和多來源證據整合方面往往面臨困難。為了解決這一挑戰，我們介紹了ChemDiffAgent，首個用於工具整合化學推理的掩碼擴散語言代理。它將化學推理重新定義為在交錯的推理和工具使用軌跡上進行迭代去噪，從而使工具使用決策能夠在完整軌跡上下文中共同確定，並更好地將代理的決策邊界與其知識邊界對齊。我們進一步分析了這一範式如何通過訓練期間更難的填充子問題和推理期間靈活的任意順序解碼來促進代理推理。然後，我們開發了一個兩階段的後訓練框架，包括代理監督微調和方差降低的偏好優化，以增強工具使用和推理能力。我們還構建了一個全面的基準，涵蓋六個化學任務，涉及單回合和多回合工具使用場景。在匹配的預算和評估下，ChemDiffAgent始終優於自回歸代理，整體改善約為20%。值得注意的是，我們的8B模型在某些情況下達到的性能可與顯著更大的前沿模型（如GPT 5.5和Claude Opus 4.7）相媲美，甚至超越它們。代碼可在https://github.com/bilemond/ChemDiffAgent獲得。
